zechariah.9.p1.b1.text: This is the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach and Damascus its resting place … Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets. … Behold, the Lord will impoverish her … she will be consumed by fire.

zechariah.9.p1.b2.text: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony … I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

zechariah.9.p1.b3.text: But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro … for now I keep watch with My own eyes.

zechariah.9.p1.b4.text: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

zechariah.9.p1.b5.text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

zechariah.9.p2.b1.text: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit. Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope …

zechariah.9.p2.b2.text: For I will bend Judah as My bow … Then the LORD will appear over them, and His arrow will go forth like lightning. … The LORD of Hosts will shield them. …

zechariah.9.p2.b3.text: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people; for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land.

zechariah.9.p2.b4.text: How lovely they will be, and how beautiful! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the young women.
